label: a door.
why: A white front door with a curtained window fills the middle of the frame while a woman in a striped smock opens it, steps out, and the door swings back toward closed. The interval sits after the cuts and whip pans flagged between 1.75 s and 2.75 s, and covers the full open-and-close swing, with the woman partly in front of the door only at the start.
